title: Blocks and gadgets substituted for distinctions and knots
claim: Proved by hand: knot substitution by a gadget that treats its terminals alike is decided at the first level (kept, freed, terminals forced equal, or ended); unlagged block triples keep the outer law; with the block's own knots between copies substitution never ends, a spare distinction's part is never tied, and a rigid template pins every part; with every distinct triple and 5 or more distinctions substitution ends every pattern with a knot (N5 narrowed). Exact on frozen ranges: with the block's own knots, 47 of 87 blocks tie a part across the whole of chains of 4, 8 and 16 knots and drawn nestings, after one and two substitutions, from patterns and mostly blocks with no ties; the tied parts were exactly those of the distinctions that are not spare (4,850 roots; 300 blocks one size past, descriptive). Referee pending.
failure_conditions: A spare distinction whose part is tied outside its copy.
A distinction that is not spare whose part is untied on a connected test pattern.
A pattern with a knot that lives under every distinct triple with a block of 5 or more distinctions.
remaining_obligations: Independent referee (the background referee thread): pending.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; blocks of 3 to 6 distinctions (and 300 of 6 and 7 past the range); chains of up to 16 knots and drawn three-copy nestings to level 3, one or two substitutions; two gadgets to levels 4 and 5.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-12, pre-registered (commit 456d7a49e); independent referee pending with the background referee thread.
validation.status: lemmas by hand; exact census on frozen ranges (check.py); descriptive checks after the run (after_run_locking.py, stress_one_size_past.py); referee pending
